purpose: Admit a limited possibility with a reservation.
keywords: I can eat it, but it is a little too spicy.
It is possible to walk, but it is far.
restrictions: Double negation weakly affirms rather than strongly recommending.
mistake: 食べられないことはない means it is possible to eat, with some hesitation.

segments.role: Admit a limited possibility with a reservation. Negative predicate + ことはない
